1	# Global Aid Alliance — Together We Respond
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	Global Aid Alliance is a humanitarian nonprofit organization dedicated to disaster relief, emergency assistance, and community resilience worldwide. Founded in 1947, the organization mobilizes volunteers, donors, and partners to deliver critical aid when and where it's needed most. Our tone is professional yet warm — conveying urgency without despair, and hope grounded in action.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #C41E3A (primary red), #1B3A5C (navy blue), #FFFFFF (white)
     7	
     8	## Header Navigation
     9	- About Us
    10	- Disaster Relief
    11	- Programs & Services
    12	- Volunteer
    13	- Find Local Chapter
    14	- Donate (button, primary red)
    15	
    16	Utility links: Sign In · Contact Us · Español
    17	
    18	## Hero Content
    19	Title: "When Disaster Strikes, We're There"
    20	Subtitle: "From hurricanes and wildfires to global health emergencies, Global Aid Alliance delivers immediate relief and long-term recovery support to communities in crisis."
    21	CTA Primary: "Donate Now"
    22	CTA Secondary: "Become a Volunteer"
    23	
    24	## Mission Statement
    25	**Our Mission:** Global Aid Alliance prevents and alleviates human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.
    26	
    27	We are guided by the fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, and neutrality. Every day, our teams work across borders and boundaries to ensure that help reaches those who need it most — regardless of race, religion, nationality, or political affiliation. From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities every step of the way.
    28	
    29	## Impact Statistics
    30	- **12 million** people assisted annually
    31	- **50,000 volunteers** active across our network
    32	- **190 countries** where we've provided aid
    33	- **$850 million raised** in the last fiscal year
    34	
    35	These figures represent real lives changed — families sheltered after storms, blood delivered to hospitals, and communities rebuilt stronger than before.
    36	
    37	## Programs and Services
    38	- **Disaster Relief** — Rapid deployment of emergency shelter, food, water, and medical supplies to communities affected by natural disasters and conflict. Our response teams are on the ground within 24 hours.
    39	- **Blood Donation** — Operating one of the largest blood collection networks, we supply approximately 40% of the nation's blood and blood products to hospitals and medical facilities.
    40	- **Emergency Preparedness** — Training individuals, families, and organizations to prepare for and respond to emergencies through workshops, certification courses, and community drills.
    41	- **International Humanitarian Aid** — Partnering with a global network of humanitarian organizations to deliver relief and recovery programs in conflict zones and disaster-affected regions worldwide.
    42	- **Community Health** — Providing health and safety education, disease prevention programs, and support services to underserved communities, including mental health resources for disaster survivors.
    43	
    44	## Get Involved
    45	**Volunteer With Us**
    46	Join over 50,000 volunteers who give their time and skills to help people in need. Whether you can commit a few hours a month or deploy to a disaster zone, there's a role for you.
    47	CTA: "Find Volunteer Opportunities"
    48	
    49	**Start a Fundraiser**
    50	Rally your community, workplace, or school to raise funds for disaster relief. We provide toolkits and support to help you make the biggest impact.
    51	CTA: "Start Your Fundraiser"
    52	
    53	**Give Blood**
    54	Every two seconds, someone in the country needs blood. Schedule an appointment at a blood drive near you and help save lives.
    55	CTA: "Find a Blood Drive"
    56	
    57	## Latest News
    58	- **Hurricane Response Update** — Global Aid Alliance teams are providing shelter and supplies to over 15,000 families displaced by Hurricane Marlena along the Gulf Coast. Relief operations are ongoing across 12 counties.
    59	- **Wildfire Relief Efforts** — Emergency shelters have been opened in three western states as crews battle record-breaking wildfires. Volunteers are distributing meals, water, and comfort kits to evacuees.
    60	- **Blood Drive Campaign** — Our summer blood drive campaign has collected over 120,000 units so far, but hospitals still face critical shortages. New donation sites have been added nationwide.
    61	- **Volunteer Spotlight** — Meet Daniela Torres, a disaster response volunteer who has deployed to seven emergencies in three years. Her story of service inspires communities across the country.
    62	
    63	## Donate Call-to-Action
    64	Title: "Your Gift Makes a Difference"
    65	Body: "A donation of any size helps us respond to disasters, train volunteers, and support communities in crisis. 91 cents of every dollar goes directly to humanitarian services."
    66	
    67	| Amount | Impact |
    68	|--------|--------|
    69	| $25 | Provides 5 emergency blankets for displaced families |
    70	| $50 | Supplies a family with food and water for one week |
    71	| $100 | Funds emergency shelter materials for a household |
    72	| $250 | Equips a volunteer with disaster response training |
    73	| Custom | Every dollar counts toward saving lives |
    74	
    75	CTA: "Donate Now"
    76	
    77	## Footer Navigation
    78	Programs: Disaster Relief · Blood Donation · Emergency Preparedness · International Aid · Community Health
    79	Get Involved: Volunteer · Donate · Start a Fundraiser · Corporate Partnerships
    80	About: Our Mission · Leadership · Financials · Careers · Press Room
    81	Support: Contact Us · FAQs · Find Local Chapter · Privacy Policy · Terms of Service
    82	
    83	Tagline: © 2024 Global Aid Alliance. All rights reserved. A 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Tax ID: 53-0196742
    84	
    85	Social: Facebook · X (Twitter) · Instagram · LinkedIn · YouTube

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Global Aid Alliance — Together We Respond</title>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Merriweather:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --primary-red: #C41E3A;
      --primary-red-dark: #A01830;
      --navy: #1B3A5C;
      --navy-dark: #142B45;
      --white: #FFFFFF;
      --gray-50: #F8F9FA;
      --gray-100: #F1F3F5;
      --gray-200: #E9ECEF;
      --gray-300: #DEE2E6;
      --gray-400: #CED4DA;
      --gray-500: #ADB5BD;
      --gray-600: #868E96;
      --gray-700: #495057;
      --gray-800: #343A40;
      --gray-900: #212529;
      --font-heading: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      --font-body: 'Merriweather', serif;
      --transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after {
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-body);
      color: var(--gray-800);
      line-height: 1.7;
      background: var(--white);
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      line-height: 1.2;
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Header */
    .header {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      z-index: 1000;
      background: var(--white);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: box-shadow var(--transition);
    }

    .header.scrolled {
      box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    .header-top {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      padding: 6px 0;
    }

    .header-top .container {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      gap: 20px;
    }

    .header-top a {
      opacity: 0.85;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .header-top a:hover {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .header-main {
      padding: 14px 0;
    }

    .header-main .container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .logo-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      background: var(--primary-red);
      border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .nav-desktop {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .nav-desktop a {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      transition: color var(--transition);
      position: relative;
    }

    .nav-desktop a::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -4px;
      left: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--primary-red);
      transition: width var(--transition);
    }

    .nav-desktop a:hover {
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    .nav-desktop a:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      padding: 12px 28px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--primary-red);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: var(--primary-red-dark);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.3);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--navy);
      border: 2px solid var(--navy);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .btn-white {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .btn-white:hover {
      background: var(--gray-100);
    }

    .btn-outline-white {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--white);
      border: 2px solid var(--white);
    }

    .btn-outline-white:hover {
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .hamburger {
      display: none;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 5px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      padding: 4px;
    }

    .hamburger span {
      display: block;
      width: 24px;
      height: 2px;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(1) {
      transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(2) {
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hamburger.active span:nth-child(3) {
      transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
    }

    .mobile-nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      right: -100%;
      width: 80%;
      max-width: 320px;
      height: 100vh;
      background: var(--white);
      z-index: 1001;
      padding: 80px 32px 32px;
      transition: right var(--transition);
      box-shadow: -4px 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .mobile-nav.open {
      right: 0;
    }

    .mobile-nav a {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      padding: 12px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      color: var(--gray-800);
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-nav a:hover {
      color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .mobile-nav .btn-primary {
      margin-top: 16px;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .mobile-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      z-index: 1000;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .mobile-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    /* Hero */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-dark) 100%);
      color: var(--white);
      padding-top: 120px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    .hero .container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .hero-content {
      max-width: 680px;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .hero p {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
      opacity: 0.9;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 560px;
    }

    .hero-buttons {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* Mission */
    .mission {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .mission-content {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .mission h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-bottom: 32px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .mission p {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .mission p:last-child {
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    /* Impact Stats */
    .impact-stats {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
    }

    .stat-item {
      text-align: center;
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--primary-red);
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--gray-700);
    }

    .stats-note {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 48px;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    /* Programs */
    .programs {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }

    .section-header h2 {
      font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .section-header p {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      max-width: 600px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .accordion {
      max-width: 800px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .accordion-item {
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .accordion-header {
      width: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 24px 0;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      text-align: left;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .accordion-header:hover {
      color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .accordion-icon {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      position: relative;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      margin-left: 16px;
    }

    .accordion-icon::before,
    .accordion-icon::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      background: currentColor;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .accordion-icon::before {
      width: 12px;
      height: 2px;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    .accordion-icon::after {
      width: 2px;
      height: 12px;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    }

    .accordion-item.open .accordion-icon::after {
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(90deg);
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .accordion-body {
      max-height: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: max-height var(--transition), padding var(--transition);
    }

    .accordion-item.open .accordion-body {
      max-height: 300px;
      padding-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .accordion-body p {
      color: var(--gray-700);
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    /* Get Involved */
    .get-involved {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .involved-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 32px;
    }

    .involved-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 40px 32px;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);
    }

    .involved-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    .involved-icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: var(--primary-red);
      color: var(--white);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
    }

    .involved-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .involved-card p {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* News */
    .news {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .news-carousel-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .news-carousel {
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .news-track {
      display: flex;
      transition: transform var(--transition);
    }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 16px);
      margin-right: 32px;
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
    }

    .news-card:last-child {
      margin-right: 0;
    }

    .news-image {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      background: var(--gray-300);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .news-content {
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .news-content h3 {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .news-content p {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    .news-nav {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 32px;
    }

    .news-nav button {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-300);
      background: var(--white);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .news-nav button:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary-red);
      color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .news-nav button:disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    /* Donate CTA */
    .donate-cta {
      padding: 100px 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-dark) 100%);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .donate-cta .section-header h2,
    .donate-cta .section-header p {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .donate-cta .section-header p {
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .donate-table {
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto 40px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    }

    .donate-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 20px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      transition: background var(--transition);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .donate-row:last-child {
      border-bottom: none;
    }

    .donate-row:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }

    .donate-row input[type="radio"] {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      margin-right: 16px;
      accent-color: var(--primary-red);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .donate-amount {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      min-width: 80px;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .donate-impact {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      opacity: 0.85;
      flex: 1;
    }

    .donate-cta-button {
      text-align: center;
    }

    /* Footer */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--gray-400);
      padding: 80px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      margin-bottom: 60px;
    }

    .footer-brand {
      max-width: 280px;
    }

    .footer-brand .logo {
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-brand p {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.6;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    .footer-column h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--white);
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .footer-column a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      transition: color var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-column a:hover {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-800);
      padding-top: 32px;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-bottom p {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .social-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .social-links a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .social-links a:hover {
      background: var(--primary-red);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    /* Modal */
    .modal-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      z-index: 2000;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .modal-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 16px;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 520px;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      transform: translateY(20px) scale(0.98);
      transition: transform var(--transition);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
    }

    .modal-overlay.open .modal {
      transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
    }

    .modal-header {
      padding: 32px 32px 0;
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: flex-start;
    }

    .modal-header h2 {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .modal-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: none;
      background: var(--gray-100);
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .modal-close:hover {
      background: var(--gray-200);
      color: var(--gray-900);
    }

    .modal-body {
      padding: 24px 32px 32px;
    }

    .donation-options {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .donation-option {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 10px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .donation-option:hover {
      border-color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .donation-option.selected {
      border-color: var(--primary-red);
      background: rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.04);
    }

    .donation-option input {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      margin-right: 16px;
      accent-color: var(--primary-red);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .donation-option .amount {
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--gray-900);
      min-width: 60px;
    }

    .donation-option .impact {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .custom-amount {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    .custom-amount input {
      flex: 1;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-family: var(--font-heading);
      font-size: 1rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }

    .custom-amount input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary-red);
    }

    .modal .btn-primary {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
    }

    .modal-note {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--gray-500);
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }
      .footer-brand {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        max-width: 100%;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-desktop {
        display: none;
      }
      .hamburger {
        display: flex;
      }
      .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 32px 24px;
      }
      .involved-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .news-card {
        flex: 0 0 100%;
        margin-right: 0;
      }
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 32px;
      }
      .footer-bottom {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
      }
      .hero-buttons {
        flex-direction: column;
      }
      .hero-buttons .btn {
        width: 100%;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .stats-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .footer-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .donate-row {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 8px;
      }
    }

    /* Accessibility */
    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

    :focus-visible {
      outline: 2px solid var(--primary-red);
      outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* Animations */
    @keyframes fadeInUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    .animate-in {
      animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out forwards;
    }
  </style>
</head>

From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities every step of the way.</p>

            <div class="logo-icon" aria-hidden="true">♥</div>
            Global Aid Alliance
          </a>
          <p>Preventing and alleviating human suffering in the face of emergencies since 1947.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-column">
          <h4>Programs</h4>
          <a href="#">Disaster Relief</a>
          <a href="#">Blood Donation</a>
          <a href="#">Emergency Preparedness</a>
          <a href="#">International Aid</a>
          <a href="#">Community Health</a>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-column">
          <h4>Get Involved</h4>
          <a href="#">Volunteer</a>
          <a href="#">Donate</a>
          <a href="#">Start a Fundraiser</a>
          <a href="#">Corporate Partnerships</a>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-column">
          <h4>About</h4>
          <a href="#">Our Mission</a>
          <a href="#">Leadership</a>
          <a href="#">Financials</a>
          <a href="#">Careers</a>
          <a href="#">Press Room</a>
        </div>
        <div class="footer-column">
          <h4>Support</h4>
          <a href="#">Contact Us</a>
          <a href="#">FAQs</a>
          <a href="#">Find Local Chapter</a>
          <a href="#">Privacy Policy</a>
          <a href="#">Terms of Service</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="footer-bottom">
        <p>© 2024 Global Aid Alliance. All rights reserved. A 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Tax ID: 53-0196742</p>
        <div class="social-links">
          <a href="#" aria-label="Facebook">f</a>
          <a href="#" aria-label="X (Twitter)">X</a>
          <a href="#" aria-label="Instagram">Ig</a>
          <a href="#" aria-label="LinkedIn">in</a>
          <a href="#" aria-label="YouTube">Yt</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </footer>

  <!-- Donate Modal -->
  <div class="modal-overlay" id="modalOverlay" onclick="closeModal(event)">
    <div class="modal" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">
      <div class="modal-header">
        <h2>Make a Donation</h2>
        <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal()" aria-label="Close modal">×</button>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-body">
        <div class="donation-options">
          <label class="donation-option" onclick="selectDonation(this)">
            <input type="radio" name="modal-donate" value="25">
            <span class="amount">$25</span>
            <span class="impact">Provides 5 emergency blankets</span>
          </label>
          <label class="donation-option" onclick="selectDonation(this)">
            <input type="radio" name="modal-donate" value="50">
            <span class="amount">$50</span>
            <span class="impact">Food & water for a week</span>
          </label>
          <label class="donation-option" onclick="selectDonation(this)">
            <input type="radio" name="modal-donate" value="100">
            <span class="amount">$100</span>
            <span class="impact">Emergency shelter materials</span>
          </label>
          <label class="donation-option" onclick="selectDonation(this)">
            <input type="radio" name="modal-donate" value="250">
            <span class="amount">$250</span>
            <span class="impact">Disaster response training</span>
          </label>
          <label class="donation-option" onclick="selectDonation(this)">
            <input type="radio" name="modal-donate" value="custom">
            <span class="amount">Custom</span>
            <span class="impact">Enter your own amount</span>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class="custom-amount" id="customAmount" style="display:none;">
          <input type="number" placeholder="Enter amount (USD)" min="1">
        </div>
        <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="submitDonation()">Donate Now</button>
        <p class="modal-note">91 cents of every dollar goes directly to humanitarian services.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    // Header scroll effect
    const header = document.getElementById('header');
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 20) {
        header.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        header.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
    });

    // Mobile menu
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburger.classList.toggle('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    });

    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileNav);

    function closeMobileNav() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('open');
      hamburger.classList.remove('active');
      hamburger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    // Donate Modal
    const modalOverlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
    const customAmount = document.getElementById('customAmount');

    function openModal() {
      modalOverlay.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    }

    function closeModal(event) {
      if (!event || event.target === modalOverlay) {
        modalOverlay.classList.remove('open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
      }
    }

    function selectDonation(el) {
      document.querySelectorAll('.donation-option').forEach(opt => opt.classList.remove('selected'));
      el.classList.add('selected');
      const input = el.querySelector('input');
      input.checked = true;
      if (input.value === 'custom') {
        customAmount.style.display = 'flex';
        customAmount.querySelector('input').focus();
      } else {
        customAmount.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }

    function submitDonation() {
      const selected = document.querySelector('input[name="modal-donate"]:checked');
      if (!selected) {
        alert('Please select a donation amount.');
        return;
      }
      let amount = selected.value;
      if (amount === 'custom') {
        const customInput = customAmount.querySelector('input');
        if (!customInput.value || customInput.value < 1) {
          alert('Please enter a valid donation amount.');
          return;
        }
        amount = customInput.value;
      }
      alert('Thank you for your generosity! This would proceed to payment processing for $' + amount + '.');
      closeModal();
    }

    // Close modal on Escape key
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        closeModal();
        closeMobileNav();
      }
    });

    // Accordion
    const accordionItems = document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item');
    accordionItems.forEach(item => {
      const header = item.querySelector('.accordion-header');
      header.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
        accordionItems.forEach(i => {
          i.classList.remove('open');
          i.querySelector('.accordion-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        });
        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add('open');
          header.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        }
      });
    });

    // News Carousel
    const newsTrack = document.getElementById('newsTrack');
    const newsPrev = document.getElementById('newsPrev');
    const newsNext = document.getElementById('newsNext');
    let currentSlide = 0;

    function getSlidesPerView() {
      return window.innerWidth > 768 ? 2 : 1;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      const slidesPerView = getSlidesPerView();
      const totalSlides = newsTrack.children.length;
      const maxSlide = Math.max(0, totalSlides - slidesPerView);
      currentSlide = Math.min(currentSlide, maxSlide);
      const slideWidth = newsTrack.children[0].offsetWidth + 32;
      newsTrack.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + (currentSlide * slideWidth) + 'px)';
      newsPrev.disabled = currentSlide === 0;
      newsNext.disabled = currentSlide >= maxSlide;
    }

    newsPrev.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (currentSlide > 0) {
        currentSlide--;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    newsNext.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const slidesPerView = getSlidesPerView();
      const maxSlide = newsTrack.children.length - slidesPerView;
      if (currentSlide < maxSlide) {
        currentSlide++;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', updateCarousel);
    updateCarousel();

    // Animated counters
    const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
    let animated = false;

    function formatNumber(num) {
      if (num >= 1000000) {
        return (num / 1000000).toFixed(0) + ' million';
      }
      if (num >= 1000) {
        return num.toLocaleString();
      }
      return num.toString();
    }

    function animateCounters() {
      if (animated) return;
      const section = document.getElementById('impact-stats');
      const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < window.innerHeight * 0.8) {
        animated = true;
        statNumbers.forEach(stat => {
          const target = parseInt(stat.dataset.target);
          const prefix = stat.dataset.prefix;
          const duration = 2000;
          const start = performance.now();

          function update(now) {
            const elapsed = now - start;
            const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
            const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
            const current = Math.floor(ease * target);
            stat.textContent = prefix + formatNumber(current);
            if (progress < 1) {
              requestAnimationFrame(update);
            } else {
              stat.textContent = prefix + formatNumber(target);
            }
          }
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        });
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener('scroll', animateCounters);
    animateCounters();

    // Smooth scroll for anchor links
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
      anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        const href = this.getAttribute('href');
        if (href === '#') return;
        const target = document.querySelector(href);
        if (target) {
          e.preventDefault();
          const offset = 100;
          const top = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - offset;
          window.scrollTo({ top, behavior: 'smooth' });
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

steps.message:
The Global Aid Alliance single-page website has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what's included:

### Sections Implemented
1. **Header** — Fixed header with utility links (Sign In, Contact Us, Español), logo, desktop navigation, and a prominent red Donate button. Mobile hamburger menu with slide-out drawer.
2. **Hero** — Full-viewport gradient hero with the headline "When Disaster Strikes, We're There", subtitle, and two CTAs (Donate Now triggers modal, Become a Volunteer scrolls to section).
3. **Mission** — Centered mission statement with bold lead paragraph.
4. **Impact Stats** — Four animated counters (12 million people, 50,000 volunteers, 190 countries, $850 million) that animate when scrolled into view. Formats large numbers cleanly (e.g., "12 million").
5. **Programs & Services** — Five-item accordion (Disaster Relief, Blood Donation, Emergency Preparedness, International Humanitarian Aid, Community Health) with smooth expand/collapse.
6. **Get Involved** — Three cards for Volunteer, Start a Fundraiser, and Give Blood with icons and CTAs.
7. **Latest News** — Functional carousel with 4 news cards, previous/next navigation buttons, and responsive slide behavior (2 cards on desktop, 1 on mobile).
8. **Donate CTA** — Dark section with selectable donation amounts and impact descriptions.
9. **Footer** — Full footer with Programs, Get Involved, About, Support columns, social links, and copyright/tax info.

### Key Interactions
- **Donate Modal** — Opens from hero button, header button, and donate CTA. Includes amount selection, custom amount input, and validation.
- **Mobile Menu** — Hamburger toggles slide-out drawer with overlay; closes on link click or Escape key.
- **News Carousel** — Previous/next buttons advance through cards; disables appropriately at bounds; adapts to viewport.
- **Program Accordion** — Click to expand one at a time with smooth height transition.
- **Animated Counters** — Stats count up with easing when scrolled into viewport.
- **Smooth Scroll** — All anchor links scroll smoothly to sections.

### Design
- Color palette: deep red `#C41E3A`, navy `#1B3A5C`, clean whites and warm grays
- Typography: Inter for headings, Merriweather for body text
- Fully responsive with breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, and 480px
- No build step required — open `index.html` directly in any browser
